run_GymEnv: run a GymEnv wrapper for the mjrl_swimmer-v0 MuJoCo environment
build_MLP_policy: build an MLP Gaussian policy with hidden sizes 32x32 for the swimmer environment
build_LinearPolicy: build a LinearPolicy for the swimmer environment with a fixed random seed
train_NPG_agent: train an NPG agent with an MLP baseline and normalized step size of 0.1
run_train_agent: run train_agent for 50 iterations with 10 trajectories and GAE lambda 0.97
